# Real C2PA fixtures

Three files signed once with c2patool 0.27.22 (c2pa-rs 0.90.22) and checked in. They are the
only fixtures that are not generated by `make-fixtures.php`, because a real manifest store
(JUMBF boxes, CBOR claim, COSE_Sign1 signature with an x5chain, `c2pa.hash.data` with exclusions)
cannot be faked by hand.

| File | Base | Container details |
|---|---|---|
| `signed.jpg` | 16x16 GD JPEG | one APP11 segment with the whole store |
| `signed.png` | 16x16 GD PNG | `caBX` chunk after IHDR |
| `signed.webp` | 16x16 GD WebP | `C2PA` chunk after the VP8 bitstream, no VP8X |

Signer: the c2patool built-in test certificate (CN `C2PA Signer`, O `C2PA Test Signing Cert`),
untrusted on purpose. The tests never verify the signature; they read the manifest and check the
data hash against the bytes.

Manifest definition: `manifest.json` (claim generator "TransparAI fixture 1.0", one
`c2pa.created` action dated 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z with the IPTC digital source type
`trainedAlgorithmicMedia`).

Regenerate (workspace, not part of the plugin): `scripts/make-c2pa-fixtures.sh`. The c2patool
binary is downloaded from its GitHub release and run in a throwaway container without network
access; no timestamp authority is contacted.
